Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: scheduled JUnit pod expiry is now calculated from the last runtime. The raw summary confirms that getNextRuntime now uses lastRuntime instead of the current time, which matches the title. The title uses the conventional fix: prefix and is specific, so a teammate scanning history would understand the primary change.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#3114`] Objective: stale-pod detection for scheduled junit canaries must use the pod creation time, not the current time, so leftover pods become stale and are deleted. Implementation at head: checks/common.go changes getNextRuntime from schedule.Next(time.Now()) to schedule.Next(lastRuntime). checks/junit.go cleanupExistingPods still passes junitPod.CreationTimestamp.Local() as lastRuntime. For a scheduled canary, nextRuntime is now the first schedule tick after the pod was created. Once that tick passes, time.Now().After(nextRuntime) is true. The pod is then deleted through the existing deferred deletePod call, and skip is set to true. After the leftover pods are removed, the next scheduled run lists no pods and proceeds. This matches the suggested fix in `#3114` (schedule.Next(pod.CreationTimestamp)). The interval branch is unchanged. Automated tests: common_test.go adds TestGetNextRuntime (cron '*/15 * * * *', '`@every` 15m', and interval 900 seconds, each expecting lastRuntime + 15m) and TestGetNextRuntimeInvalidSchedule (expects nil runtime and an error). These cover the changed branch. Not implemented: the startup cleanup option in `#3114`. The issue presents it as an additional option ('would also cover'), not a required objective. The stale-pod fix alone removes the permanent block, with at most one schedule interval of delay. Limits: the full checks package was not built or tested in this review. The type of canary.Spec.Interval was not inspected, so the uint64 assignment in the new test was not confirmed to compile.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR diff (merge base 45760407 to head 05598a04) has two changed files. checks/common.go changes one line in getNextRuntime: schedule.Next(time.Now()) becomes schedule.Next(lastRuntime). This is the change required by `#3114`. checks/common_test.go is a new file with regression tests for the same function. No unrelated files or behavior changes appear in the diff. The edited getNextRuntime function is package-internal. The only caller identified in the reviewed files is cleanupExistingPods in checks/junit.go, which is the code path in `#3114`. Other callers in the checks package were not searched, so no claim is made about them. The behavior change is limited to scheduled canaries.
